description: Show the Postbox Services deliverability check console: a visual form where the user enters a domain, sees its SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, and runs further checks on it one click at a time (blacklist, spoofability, WHOIS, domain age, BIMI, AI discoverability, redirect trace, mail test). Use this when the user asks to see or show the Postbox Services deliverability checks, or wants a form or dashboard for checking a domain. To answer a specific question about a domain, call the individual check tool instead.

domain.description: Domain to open the console with, e.g. example.com. Optional.
